usedFor: Shopify raises store events, and SuperPhone receives contacts through “Create a Contact” and “Add Custom Contribution”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create a Contact” in SuperPhone
bestTemplate.why: Shoppers who left a checkout land in SuperPhone as contacts for text marketing.

watchOut: “Add Custom Contribution” in SuperPhone attaches to an existing contact, so create the contact first.
